defs.definition: Cost Tracking is opened from Home and covers all projects together, not one project. The screens are read only: they have no create or edit button.
The **Status** column of **Project Performance Overview** shows a red **Over Budget** tag on a project row. A project with no cost records shows all zeros and the same tag.
The five cards first show 0 and fill in after a few seconds.
Hovering the tab shows Project Cost Tracking With Respect to Cost Types. The breadcrumb reads **Company Reports > Costs by projects**.

A menu icon and a bar-chart icon switch views; the tooltip of the bar icon is **Graph View**. The chart has two series, **Estimate Cost** and **Actual Cost**, one pair of bars per project. This tab has no filters, export or action button.
**Company Reports > Costs by cost types**. The page has the same list and graph toggle as **Cost by Projects** and no filters or action buttons.

Columns **Project**, **Labor Name**, **Code**, then **Sub Total**, **Contingencies Cost** and **Total Costs** under the Estimated Costs group, and **Actual Costs**. The footer shows **Total Labor Estimate Cost** and **Total Labor Actual Cost**.

Same columns with **Material Name** or **Equipment Name** in place of **Labor Name**. Footers read **Total Material Estimate Cost**, **Total Material Actual Cost**, **Total Equipment Estimate Cost** and **Total Equipment Actual Cost**.
